question: GQ-001
subject: six probes that printed verdicts nothing acted on
how_i_got_here: three bugs today shared one shape — input ABSENT, not wrong. I went to teach the self-test that shape and found the suite could not fail on it either.

the_missing_test_class.what_the_suite_did: every case broke an artifact by making it WRONG — corrupt JSON, bad number, missing table
the_missing_test_class.what_it_never_did: remove the input entirely so the gate has nothing to read
the_missing_test_class.why_that_matters: all three of today bugs passed corruption and failed starvation — they are different tests

the_worse_finding.what: a probe printing FAIL did not fail the suite
the_worse_finding.proven: forced one probe to print "FAIL — forced"; suite still reported "15 passed, 0 failed" and exit 0
the_worse_finding.cause: PASS/FAIL counters were incremented only inside check(); the 6 probes are ( ) subshells and cannot touch a parent variable
the_worse_finding.consequence: six probes had been decorative for their entire existence — the same defect they exist to catch, inside the tool I use to catch it

the_fix.starvation_cases: 2 added — source-coverage with an empty sources/, retention pointed at a file that is not a database
the_fix.signalling: all 8 FAIL branches now exit 1; a probe_done helper counts each subshell status in the parent

verified_both_directions.healthy_repo: 23 passed, 0 failed, exit 0 (was 15 — the 8 probes now count)
verified_both_directions.one_probe_forced_to_fail: 22 passed, 1 failed, exit 1 (identical forcing gave 15/0 and exit 0 before)
